content.title: Quiet Writing Progress Clock | Line Advance, Ink Reset, Seamless Resumption
content.summary: A map archivist resumes green route lines after one ink reset. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One workspace, adult worker and tool remain fixed. + Visible progress accumulates monotonically. + Resource depletion motivates one reset action. + The tool resumes beyond the exact prior stopping point. + The terminal frame proves additional completed work.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one adult map archivist at a fixed oak desk with one cream route ledger, brass nib and green ink well. When the line thins, pause and dip the same nib once into the green ink. Lift the nib and hold three newly completed green route lines beside the same well.
required_anchors: One workspace, adult worker and tool remain fixed.
The tool resumes beyond the exact prior stopping point.
The terminal frame proves additional completed work.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A map archivist resumes green route lines after one ink reset. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
